description: Line heights: multiple per line on the tallest run, exact and atLeast as lengths.
format: `lineSpacing` and `lineRule` are the resolved paragraph properties; `runs` the natural single-spaced heights, in twips, of every run and inline box on one line (as the layout engine measures them); `expected` the line height in twips.

cases.description: multiple 1000 is the tallest run's natural height.
multiple applies to the tallest run on the line: 1.15 × 400 = 460.
Line spacing is per line: 1.5 lines over a line with 11 pt and 16 pt runs (heights 253 and 368) is 552 ...
... while a line of the same paragraph with only 11 pt runs is 380 (1.5 × 253 = 379.5, rounded half up).
multiple rounds half up to whole twips: 1.15 × 253 = 290.95 gives 291.
An inline picture counts as a run of its own height.
An empty line has the height of the paragraph mark.
exact is a length in twips, whatever the runs (taller content is clipped).
atLeast is the length when the tallest run is smaller ...
... and the tallest run's natural height when that is larger.
